sink.buffer: RTP timestamp-based, 4096 samples (~93ms). Identical wire behavior to A5.
quirks: Inherits all B&W A5 firmware quirks — same AirPort-Express-derived firmware family.

Slower cold-start handshake than A5 under TCP contention: up to 5 sec RTSP RECORD response when multiple receivers compete for handshake bandwidth. Use handshake-barrier mechanism on the sender to ensure cross-AP1 first-audio remains within 1ms despite per-sink handshake variance.

If chirp-based calibration runs against this device while it's in a side room or at low volume, the mic SNR drops below threshold and the measurement becomes unreliable. Calibration code boosts target speaker to 85% during the measurement window and restores afterward.

notes: Validated alongside the A5 — same protocol family, same wire format. The handshake-variance behavior under multi-receiver TCP contention motivated the M6 handshake barrier.
